Figure: NAVIS pipeline as implemented
UNTRUSTED FIELD INPUT (DPR .txt, discipline .xlsx, agent turn, browser speech)
INGESTION (POST /ingest, sha256 dedup to Job, extension allow-list)
EXTRACTION (regex pre-pass owns tags + dates; optional LLM reads intent only; forecast guard)
SCHEMA VALIDATION (ExtractedEvent, Pydantic extra='forbid', provenance mandatory)
HYBRID RETRIEVAL for recall (TAG exact w=1.0, BM25 w=0.7, DENSE MiniLM w=0.7)
RRF FUSION (w/(60+rank), top-20 pool, channel provenance kept)
FEATURE SCORING for precision (tag_overlap .32, fuzzy .20, embedding .22, date .10, discipline .06, predecessor .06)
CONFIDENCE POLICY (tau_high 0.775 / tau_low 0.5, margin >= 0.03, discipline-conflict veto)
AUTO_LINK (score >= tau_high AND margin ok; 100% precision at 50.4% coverage)
REVIEW (planner queue with evidence + clarification back to the supervisor)
NEW_ACTIVITY (score < tau_low; unplanned scope surfaced, never silently dropped)
Finding: nothing is written by the LLM - every schedule mutation goes through _apply_rollup_to_schedule() or POST /review/{id}/resolve
GRANULARITY ROLL-UP (many mentions -> one L5/L6 node; qty-based % complete; Actual Finish only at 100%)
PERSISTENCE (SQLite: activities, linked_events, review_queue, alias_lexicon, append-only audit_records, cross-upload conflict detection)
PLANNER + FIELD UI (React: Ingest, Reconcile, Schedule, Memory; every row shows confidence + source line)
INSTITUTIONAL MEMORY (GET /memory/query: actual-vs-planned duration, discipline productivity, delay causes, suggested duration)
EXPORT (POST /schedule/export, PMXML + XER write-out, no import path yet)
LEARNING LOOP (planner correction -> alias_lexicon WRITE; never read back: GAP)
Rationale: solid path is deterministic and always on; the dashed LLM path is optional and off by default (EXTRACTION_PROVIDER=rules)

Figure: NAVIS pipeline components, verified against code
Metric: 33 components audited - 25 IMPLEMENTED (76%), 4 NOT FOUND (12%), 3 PARTIAL (9%), 1 DEFECT (3%)
DEFECT: Ranking - dense feature not computed for all candidates (implemented but measurably wrong)
NOT FOUND: Learning - alias lexicon READ by matcher (write-only learning loop)
NOT FOUND: Input - scanned document / OCR
NOT FOUND: Input - Primavera PMXML / XER import (export exists, import does not)
NOT FOUND: Auth / users / project isolation
PARTIAL: browser speech-to-text input, LLM structured output extraction, analytics (duration / productivity / delay)
Data source: every row traced to a file and symbol in research/NAVIS_TECHNICAL_AUDIT.md
Figure: Retrieval / ranking ablation and the precision-coverage frontier
Metric: Top-1 accuracy and Recall@5 over 242 gold-positive mentions, identical events to eval.py
EXACT (tag only) - 5.0 top-1 / 30.6 recall@5
BM25 (lexical only) - 93.8 top-1 / 98.8 recall@5
DENSE (MiniLM only) - 88.8 top-1 / 99.6 recall@5
HYBRID RRF (no scoring) - 92.1 top-1 / 98.3 recall@5
HYBRID + feature scoring - 87.2 top-1 / 98.3 recall@5 (89.7 with the dense-feature fix)
BM25 score gate frontier (precision falls from 100% toward 92.9% as coverage rises to ~95%)
NAVIS shipped operating point - 100% auto-link precision at ~50% coverage
NAVIS with the dense-feature fix - same 100% precision, +15.4 pts coverage
Finding: BM25 ranks better but the hybrid GATES better - the hybrid holds 100% precision at a coverage a BM25 score gate cannot reach
Data source: research/data/ablation.py, densefix.py, bm25gate.py against the real engine and dataset/ground_truth.csv
Figure: NAVIS feature-by-feature innovation profile
Metric axes (0-10): Industry novelty, Technical difficulty, SIH demo value, Defensibility
Quantity-based many-to-one roll-up + partial-scope finish guard (defensibility 8)
Deterministic date/tag extraction with LLM confined to intent only (defensibility 8)
Calibrated two-threshold + margin decision policy, measured not guessed (defensibility 8, demo value 9)
Line-lock tag rule - unique line+size match floors score at 0.93 (defensibility 8)
Institutional memory queries - durations, delays, suggested duration (demo value 9)
Character-span provenance on every extracted event (defensibility 7)
Hybrid retrieval + weighted RRF fusion (TAG 1.0 / BM25 0.7 / DENSE 0.7), defensibility 7
Rationale-list explanations, deterministic not LLM prose (defensibility 6)
Cross-upload conflict detection - earliest-start/latest-finish, disagreement recorded (defensibility 6)
Append-only audit trail - field, old->new, source line, confidence (defensibility 6)
Voice slot-filling field agent with typed fallback (defensibility 5)
Alias lexicon learning loop, currently write-only (defensibility 2 - lowest)
Finding: sorted by defensibility, the bottom of the chart is what NOT to claim
Caveat: rubric from research/INNOVATION_ANALYSIS.md - reasoned judgements against EVIDENCE.md, not measurements
